result.statement: For 1<q<2 and p=q/(q-1), a uniformly Lp-bounded core independent of a disjoint cap-one quadratic receiver bank with one fixed nonzero physical diagonal a yields ||p_Q||_infinity <= K [2^(q-1)/(2-q)]^(1/q)|a|^(-(q-1)/q), uniformly over arbitrary receiver internal curvature, affine shifts, fragments, unbounded supports and moments. At q=3/2 the receiver factor is exactly 2|a|^(-1/3). The resulting branch density is continuous.
